title: “OpenConnect” Connection information is not displayed
line: The Networks widget and the Wi-Fi & Networking settings now show the IP address, gateway and DNS servers of a connected VPN.
explanation: ConnectionDetails::getConnectionDetails() decides whether a connection is active by comparing it with device->activeConnection(). A VPN item in the widget has no device, and in the KCM it gets the base Wi-Fi/Ethernet device, whose active connection is the base connection, so a connected VPN was always treated as inactive and only its plugin name was shown. The change looks up the VPN's own active connection in NetworkManager's active connections and takes the IPv4/IPv6 configuration from it; other connection types keep using the device as before.

commits.message:
connectiondetails: show IP addresses of active VPN connections

A VPN is never the active connection of a device, so the details only
saw it as inactive and showed nothing but its plugin. Find its own
active connection instead and take the IP configuration from there.

BUG: 516854
